messages.subject: Error message in multiple-sessions
parts:
Dear all,

I am currently running multiple-sessions spatial capture recapture analyses

One session (the third one in this case) has no detections and I have included one dummy row as follows

SESSION ANIMAL_ID SO LOC_ID

……

  3      NONE  0      0

 

Before running the secr.fit I set verify=TRUE to make sure that everything is fine (except of course the session without any detection) and got following error message:

 

Checking data

Session 3

No live releases

Duplicated or missing row names (animal ID)

Error in secr.fit(lynx_capthist_NWA_VSS, mask = list(mask_13_NWA, mask_13_VSS),  :

  'verify' found errors in 'capthist' argument

 

The first three lines of the error message make sense because I do not have any detection in the 3 session, however I am not sure if the end of the message (last three lines) is also related to the fact that I do not have any detections on the third session or if there is another problem in my input data.


Many thanks in advance for a short feedback

 

Best wishes

Fridolin

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error message in multiple-sessions
parts:
Fridolin
This works for me if I provide a valid occasion number:
3   NONE 1  0
I mocked up an example and had the further problem that initial values cannot be found automatically if the empty session happens to be first. That's easily fixed by setting e.g. details=list(autoini=2).
Murray
